description: Aree di circolazione pedonale is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by borgoamozzano.ldpgis.it. Dataset containing the area intended for pedestrian circulation. It includes all the portions of the road platform that within urban areas, are reserved for the transit of pedestrians, ie the sidewalks, as well as all areas of pedestrian passage or parking such as porticoes or underpasses, pedestrian passages with or without steps, lifeguards, etc. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian traffic areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include progetto-opendata-highvalue, Reti di trasporto. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, ZIP, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
